Operator page states: "In all these areas, throughout the year, dogs must be kept on a leash and the use of drones or unmanned aircraft is prohibited." This applies to three named 'sensitive zones' on the mountain (La Manèra, La Còsta da Mügía, In Cüsell) protecting wildlife; the page does not give exact boundaries or state whether the zones include the summit/cable-car/adventure-park area itself, so treat the ban as applying to the mountain generally rather than confirmed for one precise footprint. In Cüsell additionally has a separate seasonal overflight ban (1 Dec-31 Jul) layered on top of the year-round drone/dog rule.
